text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Seriously great work at summer camp, everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sooo~ here are some souvenirs from Sapporo~.
Grab whatever you like~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait, thank you, Sweep-chan!
Your magic spray♡ was a lifesaver~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nfuh, right?~ Well, I gave it my all♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand, for Sweep-chan,
here's some magical spray in return♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If you eat this... guess what, guess what?!
You'll instantly be bursting with energy!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding☆ Nah, it's really just regular chocolate!
But it's suuuper tasty! Seriously!
I'll leave it over there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
Well, I'll take it for now.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eat up!
And then, let's battle it out on some big stage again! Deal?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I was planning to do that even if you didn't tell me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the third year's summer training camp drew to a close.
